provenance.purpose: Compute curve at 3B, 4 epochs (1104 optimizer steps). The training SET is held fixed at the published 2208-pair balanced set and only epochs vary, so the curve measures compute alone. Motivated by the hard-negative phase, where 3 epochs moved prose discordant accuracy 0.4326 -> 0.5393 on this identical data.
provenance.init: the SAME 3B prose-native pilot as every other balanced run, so the curve forks at one point
provenance.CAVEAT_crossvul: CrossVul non-held-out pairs are training data, as in every balanced run.
